text: Three test files carry the rule in CLAUDE.md that construction and search results must not change. libsufr/tests/oracle.rs rebuilds every small input under every flag set and compares against a reference sort and LCP; an input starting with > is an inline FASTA. libsufr/tests/search.rs holds hand-derived search results on fixtures 1 and 2. sufr/tests/cli.rs pins the CLI, with create_bytes_match_fixtures comparing 13 fixtures byte for byte. Checked at fc5db36.
